# Move

> Move is a calm, collaborative **moving-inventory manager**. You pack belongings into
> numbered boxes, snap a photo and let a vision model list the contents, find anything
> across the whole relocation with hybrid search, print QR labels and manifests, and tick
> items off as you unpack at the destination — solo or with a household, each with the
> right role. An MCP assistant lets an AI client query and mutate a move programmatically
> through the very same business logic as the web UI. Built on a multi-tenant **Rails 8.1
> / Ruby 4.0** stack — **no Node**, server-rendered with Phlex + Hotwire, schema-per-tenant
> isolation via Apartment.

This file is the `llms-full.txt` context dump per <https://llmstxt.org/>. It carries the
structural and institutional knowledge an AI agent needs to work in this repo. The
**operational rulebook is `AGENTS.md`** (root; `CLAUDE.md` is a symlink to it) — read it
before any non-trivial change; the conventions there are non-negotiable and OVERRIDE
defaults. This file summarizes *what the system is*; `AGENTS.md` governs *how you must
work in it*.

Authoritative companions:
- `AGENTS.md` — workflow, CLI, quality gates, deployment, hard-won gotchas (the rulebook).
- `app/actions/AGENTS.md` / `README.md` — the business-logic layer (actions → events → subscribers).
- `app/mcp/README.md` — the MCP assistant surface.
- `doc/project/architecture.md` — full runtime + tenancy architecture with Mermaid diagrams.
- `doc/project/new-app-recipe.md` — reproducible setup recipe (gems, Kamal, Cloudflare, Doppler, CI).
- `doc/phases/README.md` — design-led, screen-by-screen phase plan + screen↔phase↔design map.
- `.github/codex/review-rubric.md` — the standard every PR review applies (and the pre-PR self-review checklist).

---

## 1. System Architecture & Tech Stack

### What & why

Move is a server-rendered, multi-tenant Rails monolith for managing a physical
relocation end-to-end: **pack → recognise → search → collaborate → unpack**. Each
customer organisation is an isolated PostgreSQL schema (a "tenant"); within a tenant,
the central aggregate is a **Move** (a relocation project) containing **Boxes**, each
holding **Items**, with **Media** (photos) feeding **AI recognition** that proposes
items, **hybrid search** over confirmed items, and an append-only **activity feed**.

### Primary data flow

```
Browser → Cloudflare edge (TLS, WAF, wildcard cert)
        → Cloudflare Tunnel (outbound-only; origin has NO open inbound ports)
        → cloudflared (systemd, on origin) → kamal-proxy (plain HTTP, forwards all hosts)
        → Rails app (Puma)
            • Apartment elevator resolves the tenant from the subdomain (sets PG search_path)
            • thin controller: authorize (ActionPolicy) → call an Action → pattern-match → render (Phlex)
            • Action runs Dry::Monads railway, emits a `Rails.event` (domain.verb)
            • subscribers fan out: activity feed, search reindex (Solid Queue), audit
            • live UI via ActionCable / Turbo Streams (NO client polling)
        → PostgreSQL 18 (+ pgvector); images → SeaweedFS via Active Storage (S3)
```

The **MCP assistant** (`POST /mcp`, stateless JSON-RPC, per-Move Bearer token) reuses the
*same* actions, so it cannot bypass authorization, tenancy, or audit.

### Core stack (explicit versions)

| Layer | Choice | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Language | **Ruby 4.0.5** | pinned via **mise** (`.ruby-version`); prefix commands with `mise x --` |
| Framework | **Rails 8.1** (`~> 8.1.3`) | `schema_format :sql` → `db/structure.sql` (no `schema.rb`) |
| DB | **PostgreSQL 18** + **pgvector** (`neighbor` gem) | pinned everywhere (dev/CI/prod); needs matching `pg_dump` for tenant cloning |
| Views | **Phlex** (`phlex-rails ~> 2.0`) | server-side Ruby components; `application.html.erb` is unused — the real head is `Views::Layouts::ChromeHead` |
| Frontend | **Hotwire** (turbo-rails + stimulus-rails), **importmap-rails** | NO Node/npm; live updates over Turbo Streams |
| CSS | **Tailwind** (standalone CLI: `tailwindcss-rails` + `tailwindcss-ruby`) | no Node |
| Assets | **Propshaft** | new-asset staleness gotchas in dev (see §4/§5) |
| Multi-tenancy | **ros-apartment ~> 3.4** | schema-per-tenant; `Apartment::Elevator::Subdomain` |
| Auth | **Rodauth** (rodauth-rails) + **webauthn** + **omniauth-google-oauth2** + **rodauth-omniauth** | passwordless email links, passkeys, Google sign-in |
| Authorization | **action_policy** | admin / contributor (editor) / viewer, enforced server-side |
| Business logic | **dry-monads ~> 1.10** | Result/do-notation "railway" in `app/actions/` |
| Soft delete | **discard ~> 2.0** | `discarded_at`; cascade restore via `Discards::Cascade(Restore)` + `discard_batch_id` |
| Versioning | **logidze ~> 1.4** | Postgres-trigger field history (jsonb `log_data`); powers activity-feed revert |
| Background / cache / cable | **solid_queue / solid_cache / solid_cable** | DB-backed; Solid Queue runs in-process with Puma in prod |
| Storage | **Active Storage → SeaweedFS** (`aws-sdk-s3`), **ruby-vips** / `image_processing` | per-tenant Active Storage; libvips variants |
| AI | **mcp** gem (assistant); vision/embedding providers OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / Voyage | per-Move bring-your-own-key, encrypted at rest |
| PDFs / QR | **prawn ~> 2.5** + **prawn-table** + **rqrcode ~> 3.0** + **chunky_png** | A7 labels, A4 manifests; embed a Unicode TTF (never AFM fonts) |
| Deploy | **Kamal** + **Cloudflare Tunnel** + **Doppler** (secrets) | auto-deploy on push to `main` |
| Test / quality | **RSpec** (rspec-rails), **Capybara** + Selenium, **Brakeman**, **RuboCop** (+ custom `Move/*` cops), **erb_lint**, **bundler-audit**, **overcommit** | CI `lint` + `test` gate `main` |

---

## 2. Domain Vocabulary & Business Logic (Ubiquitous Language)

- **Organization** — a customer tenant. **One PostgreSQL schema per Organization**
  (Apartment). There is *no* `organization_id` column on tenant tables — the active schema
  *is* the org. Lives in the `public` schema registry. Reached via subdomain `<slug>.move-easy.org`.
- **User / account** — a person. Lives in the shared `public` schema (Rodauth tables).
  Referenced from tenant tables **by UUID with no cross-schema foreign key**.
- **OrganizationMembership** — joins a User to an Organization (public schema).
- **Move** — a relocation project, the central aggregate inside a tenant. Status:
  `planned → started → finished → archived`. An **archived** Move is read-only
  (`writable? == !archived?`). Has a `unit_system` (metric/imperial) and an
  `auto_confirm_threshold` (0–1). Holds **encrypted per-Move provider API keys**.
- **MoveMembership** — joins a User to a Move with a **role**: `admin` / `contributor`
  (a.k.a. *editor*) / `viewer`. Gates reads vs mutations (MovePolicy / BoxPolicy).
- **Box** — a physical container inside a Move. Lifecycle:
  `packing → sealed → in_transit → unpacking → unpacked` (a sealed box can be unsealed;
  an unpacked box can be reopened to unpacking). Has a numeric `number` (unique per Move,
  bounded to bigint), a `qr_token`, optional `room`, dimensions (`length/width/height_cm`)
  and `weight`. **Soft-deletable**; discarding a Box cascades the discard to its Items
  under one `discard_batch_id`.
- **Item** — an inventory entry in **exactly one** Box. Two orthogonal axes:
  - `review_state`: `pending_review` / `auto_confirmed` / `confirmed` / `needs_correction`.
  - `presence_state`: `in_box` / `removed` (the *unpacking* axis — independent of soft-delete).
  - `created_via`: `recognition` / `manual` / `mcp`.
  - **Searchable set** = `in_box` AND `review_state ∈ {confirmed, auto_confirmed}`.
  - Also soft-deletable (the *deletion* axis, orthogonal to `presence_state: removed`).
- **Media** — a photo attached to a Box/Move (Active Storage → SeaweedFS). Soft-deletable.
- **RecognitionRun / RecognitionSuggestion** — a vision-model pass over a photo and its
  proposed items; suggestions are materialized into Items (auto-confirmed when score ≥
  the Move's `auto_confirm_threshold`, else pending review).
- **Vocabulary** — controlled, **per-Move** lists the recognition steers toward:
  **Room**, **Category**, **Tag**. Selection-only on items; managed under `/vocabularies/:kind`.
- **ItemSearchDocument** — the hybrid-search projection (one row per item: lexical tsvector
  + trigram + optional pgvector embedding pinned to its `embedding_model`).
- **IndexingRun** — a whole-Move re-embedding pass (live ActionCable progress).
- **Activity** — append-only audit journal row (one per change). Powers **Restore**
  (undelete) and **Revert** (undo latest field edit), both editor-only.
- **MoveIntegrationToken** — a per-Move Bearer credential for the MCP endpoint (admin-only).

**Key business rules / invariants**
- Tenancy isolation is structural (schema), never a `where(organization_id:)`. Never
  hand-roll subdomain resolution or org scoping — use Apartment.
- Recognition & embeddings are **strict per-Move BYO key** — a real provider needs *this
  Move's own* key; it never falls back to a shared key. `fake` providers are network-free
  defaults. If no embedding key, search **degrades gracefully** to lexical + trigram.
- A QR token from another org's schema is simply absent on resolution → a non-disclosing
  "unrecognized" state (cross-tenant lookups can't leak).
- Items are scoped to the **Move** (not the box) so they survive a box-to-box move; the
  box label/manifest scope to the box.
- The vector space is an invariant: a search leg is pinned to `embedding_model` so a
  stale-space vector degrades to lexical rather than mis-ranking.

---

## 3. State of the Codebase (Where Things Live)

### High-level directory map (why each exists)

```
app/
  actions/        ← ALL business logic. One Domain::Verb < BaseAction per operation
                    (Dry::Monads). Subfolders by aggregate: moves/ boxes/ items/
                    captures/ recognition_runs/ reviews/ search/ vocabularies/
                    move_memberships/ move_integration_tokens/ organizations/
                    manifests/ qr/ indexing_runs/ discards/. Has its own AGENTS.md.
  controllers/    ← THIN. authorize → call action → pattern-match → render. One per surface.
  components/     ← Phlex view components (Base, UI library under ui/, icons/).
  views/          ← Phlex view classes (incl. rodauth/ overrides, layouts/ChromeHead, pwa/).
  models/         ← Persistence only: associations, validations, scopes. NO domain logic.
  policies/       ← ActionPolicy authorization (MovePolicy, BoxPolicy, …).
  subscribers/    ← Rails.event subscribers (activity/ captures/ manifests/ search/).
  jobs/           ← Solid Queue jobs (recognition_runs/, search/, purge_abandoned_uploads).
  services/       ← Provider adapters: recognition_providers/, embedding_providers/,
                    image_normalizer, provider_http. (Integration glue, not domain rules.)
  mcp/            ← MCP server + tool definitions (move_mcp/). Reuses app/actions. Own README.
  pdfs/           ← Prawn PDF generators (labels, manifests). Embed a Unicode TTF.
  presenters/ helpers/ mailers/ channels/ misc/ (Rodauth auth glue — see app/misc/AGENTS.md)
config/
  routes.rb       ← Routing hub. Heavily commented, screen-keyed (A1, B1, C2, …).
  initializers/   ← apartment.rb, apartment_elevator.rb, rodauth.rb, roles.rb,
                    search_indexing.rb, recognition_broadcast.rb, activity_log.rb,
                    mcp_audit.rb, manifest_audit.rb, phlex.rb, structure_sql.rb, …
  deploy.yml      ← Kamal (app + postgres:18 accessory). Secrets via Doppler.
db/
  structure.sql   ← schema_format :sql (NO schema.rb). Must match migrations (overcommit hook).
  seeds.rb        ← Demo org/move/account. Guarded OFF in production. Tenancy-aware.
lib/
  rubocop/cop/move/  ← Custom cops: broad_rescue.rb, database_aggregation.rb (merge-blocking).
  tasks/             ← search.rake, rubocop.rake, erblint.rake.
spec/               ← RSpec. Incl. spec/architecture/ (fitness tests enforcing §1 rules).
doc/
  project/        ← architecture.md, new-app-recipe.md, ai-providers.md, diagrams/.
  phases/         ← Design-led phase plan (D0–D13) + Steps logs + DESIGN-DISCREPANCIES.md.
  ai/             ← Domain-led companion plan (v0.2 prompts).
bin/cli           ← Thor CLI piloting app/db/mail/storage/services containers.
```

### Key files / primes (core logic entry points)

- **Routing hub**: `config/routes.rb` — every surface, screen-keyed and commented.
- **Action base / railway**: `app/actions/base_action.rb` (+ `app/actions/AGENTS.md`).
- **Core schema/domain**: `app/models/move.rb`, `box.rb`, `item.rb` (read these first).
- **Tenancy**: `config/initializers/apartment.rb` + `apartment_elevator.rb`.
- **Auth**: `config/initializers/rodauth.rb` + `app/misc/` (+ `app/misc/AGENTS.md` for gotchas).
- **Authorization roles**: `config/initializers/roles.rb`, `app/policies/`.
- **Live updates / events**: `recognition_broadcast.rb`, `search_indexing.rb`,
  `activity_log.rb` initializers + `app/subscribers/`.
- **MCP**: `app/controllers/mcp_controller.rb`, `app/mcp/move_mcp/` (+ `app/mcp/README.md`).
- **Custom enforcement**: `lib/rubocop/cop/move/*`, `spec/architecture/`.

### Schemas / state systems

- **Database**: PostgreSQL 18, `schema_format :sql` (`db/structure.sql`). `public` schema
  holds shared/auth/registry tables (`users`, `user_*_keys`, `organizations`,
  `organization_memberships`); each org is its own schema (moves, boxes, items, media,
  vocabularies, activities, …), cloned from `public` with excluded tables omitted.
- **Caching / jobs / websockets**: Solid Cache / Solid Queue / Solid Cable (all DB-backed).
- **Sessions**: cookie-based (`session_store.rb`). Cross-domain auth currently uses a
  **shared `.move-easy.org` cookie** (see §4 tech debt #280).

  **confirm scope with the user before starting new feature work.**

### Current bottlenecks / technical debt (be careful not to break)
- **#280 — cross-domain auth uses a shared `.move-easy.org` cookie**, not the spec'd
  token-handoff. This is the one open, foundational follow-up (auth + tenancy — do it in
  plan mode). No multi-org users yet.
- **`recognition_poller_controller.js`** is the one remaining JS poller (recovery
  surface), grandfathered; #244 closed. **Do not add new pollers** — rule §1.4 forbids them.
- **Dev asset staleness** (not code bugs, prod precompiles fresh): new Stimulus
  controllers and new Tailwind utilities are invisible in dev until
  `assets:precompile` / `tailwindcss:build` + `bin/cli app restart`. See §5 anti-patterns.

### First task on resume
There is **no active feature phase queued**. Resume by confirming scope with the user.
The only standing engineering follow-up is **#280** (token-handoff tenant-isolation
migration). Otherwise the codebase is in a green, released state.

## 5. Rules of Engagement & Patterns

> These mirror **AGENTS.md §1** (non-negotiable) and the recurring gotchas. The four
> architecture rules are enforced by `spec/architecture/` and the `Move/*` RuboCop cops —
> violations are **merge-blocking**, not advisory.

### Design standards (strictly enforced)
1. **Multi-tenancy → Apartment gem.** Never hand-roll subdomain resolution,
   `Current.organization` scoping, or `organization_id` filtering. Tenant = schema.
2. **Business logic → `app/actions/`, never in models.** Every operation is a
   `Domain::Verb < BaseAction` using Dry::Monads result/do-notation and emitting a
   `domain.verb` `Rails.event`. Models stay persistence-only; controllers stay thin.
3. **Live-test authentication after every change.** Auth (passwordless Rodauth +
   remember-me + Apartment elevator) is fragile; a green suite is NOT sufficient. Verify
   create → sign in → sign out → sign back in in the running app.
4. **Live updates → ActionCable / Turbo Streams. JS polling is FORBIDDEN.** Push
   server-side state over turbo-rails broadcasting (an action emits an event → a subscriber
   re-renders the Phlex view → `Turbo::StreamsChannel.broadcast_replace_to`). Signed stream
   names derived from a tenant-unique uuid are the auth boundary.
5. **Aggregation / filtering → the database, never Ruby.** No `pluck(...).map/min/max/sum`,
   no `.select { }.count`, no `.to_a.sum`. Use SQL (`minimum`/`maximum`/`sum`/`count`,
   `pick(Arel.sql(...))`, `group(:x).count`, `exists?`, `distinct`). **Coerce `Arel.sql`
   aggregate outputs** (`&.to_i`/`&.to_f`) — untyped casts come back as **strings**
   (lexical `"9" > "10"` bug).

### Patterns to follow
- **Result pattern**: actions return Dry::Monads `Success`/`Failure`; controllers
  pattern-match. No raised exceptions for expected failure paths.
- **Side effects via events, not model callbacks**: action emits `Rails.event` → subscriber
  → (often) a Solid Queue job. (Search reindex is the reference impl.)
- **A broadcast/subscriber must never break its emitter**: a `Rails.event` subscriber runs
  synchronously inside the emitting action — wrap render/broadcast in a `rescue` (or enqueue
  a job). This is the *only* sanctioned `rescue StandardError`, and must opt out per-site:
  `# rubocop:disable Move/BroadRescue -- <reason>`.
- **UI is built against Google Stitch designs**, not imagination — open the canonical
  Stitch screen + the Phase D0 design tokens before any customer-facing UI work (AGENTS.md
  "Design source of truth"). No magic colour/spacing/radius values.
- **Seed data is part of the deliverable** — extend `db/seeds.rb` (idempotent,
  tenancy-aware, comprehensive states) for any new user-facing surface.
- **PDFs must embed a Unicode TTF** (`PdfFonts` mixin) before rendering user text — never
  the built-in AFM fonts (they raise on accents/emoji).

### Anti-patterns to avoid (banned)
- ❌ `organization_id` columns / manual tenant scoping (use Apartment schemas).
- ❌ Domain logic in models or fat controllers (use `app/actions/`).
- ❌ JS polling (`setInterval`+`fetch`, Stimulus pollers, refresh meta tags).
- ❌ Loading rows into Ruby to compute counts/sums/min/max/filters (push to SQL).
- ❌ Bare `rescue StandardError` outside the sanctioned broadcast-isolation site.
- ❌ Inline `on*` event handlers in Phlex (`onchange`/`onclick`) — Phlex raises; use a
  Stimulus controller + `data-action`.
- ❌ Inventing UI not in Stitch; using non-"Refined Palette" screens as canonical.
- ❌ `[skip ci]` / `[ci skip]` / `[no ci]` markers in commits (they skip the prod deploy
  via squash-merge); `[skip deploy]` only when truly intended.
- ❌ Ending a PR on a docs-only commit (path-ignored CI never produces required checks →
  `BLOCKED`). Keep a code-touching commit at HEAD.
- ❌ Raw `Model.create!` in runner scripts (use FactoryBot factories — they encode required
  associations).
- ❌ "Written by Claude" / "Claude Code" in commit messages (forbidden by global rules).

### Workflow rules (from AGENTS.md)
- **Issue first**, then branch from `main` (`feature/*` `fix/*` `docs/*` `refactor/*`),
  atomic commits (`#<issue> Subject`), live `/product-review`, PR (`Closes #<issue>`).
- **Wait for + address the Codex automated review** on every PR before declaring done;
  reply to and resolve every comment.
- **Prefix Ruby commands with `mise x --`**; `unset GITHUB_TOKEN` before `gh`.
- **Pre-commit gates** (mirror CI): `rubocop`, `erb_lint --lint-all`, `brakeman
  --exit-on-warn`, `bundle-audit check --update`, RSpec unit + system. overcommit enforces
  these + `RailsSchemaUpToDate` (structure.sql must match migrations).
- `main` is protected; push to `main` auto-deploys to prod via Kamal.
- When a defect class escapes review, **add/extend a cop or fitness test** — don't just
  re-remind.

### Local dev quick reference
- Dev URLs: `https://move.move-easy.docker` (apex), org subdomain e.g.
  `acme.move-easy.docker`; mail at `https://mail.move-easy.docker`.
  (Per agent memory, `/product-review` access is `http://acme.move-easy.docker:8080`
  HTTP — verify against memory `dev-product-review-access`.)
- `bin/cli services start`, `bin/rails db:seed`. Demo: `demo@example.com`, org `acme`,
  move "Seattle Relocation". Magic links are single-use.
- Prod demo account: `jlstaar@gmail.com` → `demo.move-easy.org` (NEVER bypass auth for any
  real user).
